newsitem.title: USA: Apple South to buy Canyon Cafes.
newsitem.headline: Apple South to buy Canyon Cafes.

text.p: Apple South Inc. said Thursday it agreed to acquire Canyon Cafes Inc. for $30.6 million in cash and $5.4 million in Apple South common stock. Apple South said it also will assume about $6 million in debt.
The Madison, Ga.-based restaurant operator said it expects the merger to close within 30 days.

Canyon Cafes, which specialises in Southwestern cuisine, will operate as a division of Apple South, which already operates 363 restaurants. Canyon, based in Dallas, has 13 restaurants in Arizona, California, Colorado, Georgia, Missouri, Texas and Washington, D.C.

Apple South operates 241 Applebee's Neighbourhood Grill & Bar restaurants, 75 Don Pablo's Mexican Kitchen restaurants, 16 McCormick & Schmick's seafood dinner houses, 21 Hops Grill & Bar restaurants and 10 Harrigan's Grill and Bar restaurants.
Apple South's stock fell 12.5 cents to $15.75 on Nasdaq in late trading.
